evidence.title: SOP-07: lid open overnight
evidence.claim: In 2012, staff suggested the step was for tank drying or acetone vapour removal, though the exact reason was uncertain.
evidence.quote: So the tank dries. Reply from E. Marchisio: I always understood it was to let the acetone vapour out

evidence.title: SOP-07 Solvent cleaning of dispersers and mixing vessels
evidence.claim: The step was present in the 1998 procedure, coinciding with the addition of a xylene wipe.
evidence.quote: Added xylene wipe of agitator (CR-1998-009). Lid left open overnight.

evidence.title: SOP-07 Solvent cleaning of dispersers and mixing vessels
evidence.claim: In 2000, the procedure required leaving the lid open overnight followed by a 60-minute wait for acetone vapours to clear.
evidence.quote: Leave lid open overnight. 7. Wait 60 min before charging next batch (acetone vapour must clear before hot charge).

evidence.title: SOP-07 Solvent cleaning of dispersers and mixing vessels
evidence.claim: In 2014, the step to leave the lid open overnight remained, although the subsequent wait time before charging was reduced to 15 minutes.
evidence.quote: 7. Leave lid open overnight. 8. Wait at least 15 min before charging next batch.

evidence.title: EHS memo - xylene exposure reduction
evidence.claim: As of 2021, xylene is still used for the agitator wipe in SOP-07, which is the process containing the step under investigation.
evidence.quote: Xylene is now used at the plant only for the agitator wipe in SOP-07

evidence.title: Change request CR-2015-004
evidence.claim: In 2015, the wait time after cleaning was restored to 60 minutes because residual acetone vapour caused flammable atmospheres and film defects during hot charging.
evidence.quote: residual acetone vapour combined with hot charging gives a flammable atmosphere and film defects

evidence.title: Incident report IR-2008-003
evidence.claim: In 2008, an operator suffered dizziness due to high acetone vapour concentrations (above 5,000 ppm) inside tank T-3 after cleaning.
evidence.quote: became dizzy after about 2 minutes. A colleague pulled him out; he recovered in the infirmary

evidence.title: Deviation report DR-2015-006
evidence.claim: In 2015, residual acetone caused flammable atmospheres and product defects when charging hot after only 15 minutes of venting.
evidence.quote: LEL alarm at 35 % during charging; the batch showed popping and craters attributed to residual acetone.

evidence.title: Change request CR-2008-005
evidence.claim: In 2008, a safety change was requested for SOP-07 following an incident where an operator was overcome by solvent vapour in tank T-3.
evidence.quote: Reason: IR-2008-003 (operator overcome by solvent vapour in tank T-3).

verdict.process_name: SOP-07 solvent cleaning of dispersers and mixing vessels
verdict.instruction: Leave the vessel lid open overnight after cleaning.
verdict.reason: The step prevents flammable atmospheres and product defects (popping/craters) caused by residual acetone vapour during hot charging, as well as operator dizziness from high vapour concentrations.
